purpose: Original imagined coastal rock material for the Ocean tides shore. This is illustrative material, not a photograph of a real coast or geological measurement.
production: AI-generated original rock material using OpenAI image generation; resized to 1152 × 768 and encoded as WebP quality 82. Previously used on authored 3D terrain and the SVG rocky profile; replaced by shore-sand.webp on 29 October 2026.
other_assets: The small Earth globe reuses earth.webp and its existing NASA/Solar System Scope credits in ILLUSTRATION_SOURCES.json.
limits: The mean beach water level uses two sinusoidal high/low tides per illustrative lunar day, with amplitude linked to the shared global tide range. Scenario presets compare the same high-water phase. The closer-Moon example uses an illustrative 0.95 mean-distance ratio and inverse-cube lunar forcing, not a date-specific perigee or real coastal forecast. The terrain is imagined; small waves, reflections, foam and wet sand are visual approximations that do not alter the tide calculation. Real daily tide patterns, heights and timings depend on location and weather.

water_material.purpose: Original illustrated ocean-surface material used for optical detail in the 3D coastal water.
water_material.production: AI-generated original dark ocean material using OpenAI image generation, encoded as WebP quality 85 without resizing. It supplies appearance rather than measured wave or tide data.
water_material.provenance: Generated for this project; no external photograph was used as an input.

status: Retired material: shore-rock.webp belongs to the earlier rocky scene and is not used by the current sandy beach.

sand_material.status: Active material for the detailed 3D beach and simpler SVG fallback.
sand_material.purpose: Original imagined fine beach sand material. This is generated illustration, not a photograph, geological sample or survey of a real beach.
sand_material.production: AI-generated original sand material using OpenAI image generation; encoded as WebP quality 85 without resizing. Mapped onto an authored beach shape; wetness, lighting and water are separate rendered layers.
sand_material.provenance: Generated for this project; supplies visual material rather than measured scientific data.
